# Ruby Gillis & Susan

- [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) — Sibling of — [Susan](../character/susan.md) — sister · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P17](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0017)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> As life in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) settles back into a routine after the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) turns thirteen and walks along [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), discussing her birthday, a fictional story she wrote, and the idea of forming a story club. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explains the newly formed story club to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who scoffs at the endeavor as a foolish waste of time while reminding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to focus on her chores.
